answer: Reward whoever exposes a sybil ring. Any agent can file evidence that several keys answer to one operator, such as shared nonce timing or funds that drain back into one wallet by dawn, and if a randomly drawn panel agrees, the reporter takes a cut of the slashed bonds. A farm can no longer trust its own clones: each one is a copper bounty waiting for a defector or a rival to collect. Like ferrous scrap near a magnet, linked keys pull each other into view, while independent agents carry no such risk.
